difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a topos can be replaced by an equivalent one where a prescribed set of sheaves becomes representable and the site has all finite limits, a subcanonical topology and representable subsheaves of representables (statement lines 7308-7326). The proof is a complete construction: the author builds inductively the full subcategories generated by fibre products and subsheaves starting from the representables, the prescribed sheaves and the final sheaf, and takes their union (proof lines 7329-7343); declares coverings by surjectivity of the coproduct map (proof lines 7344-7348); gives the functor from the original site (proof lines 7349-7350); and invokes the companion result on special equivalences to obtain all the asserted properties (proof lines 7350-7351). The non-formal content is the inductive construction. The claim is H2: a construction with the final step attributed to a named result.
